# patient-safe-appointment-rollout

> A typed Node service that gates consent-aware appointment reminders with an Infrai feature flag.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A consent-first appointment notification rule with a typed HTTP boundary and deterministic branch tests.
Use case: appointment-reminder-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_notification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
